parameters.description: Pointer to a RECTL structure that defines the area to be modified. This structure uses the coordinate system of the destination surface. The lower and right edges of this rectangle are not part of the bit-block transfer, the rectangle is lower right exclusive. DrvBitBlt is never called with an empty destination rectangle.
